name: Zentor
description:
Zentor is the artificial intelligence platform that lets you manage pricing, promotions, and advertising for each of your Mercado Libre listings.

Zentor continuously analyzes variables such as costs, profitability, competition, stock, demand, and business goals to make decisions automatically, dynamically, and intelligently, helping you increase profitability without spending hours manually managing each listing.

Unlike traditional automation, Zentor works with dynamic pricing. It does not simply execute fixed rules; it analyzes the context of each listing to determine the most appropriate price and promotion at any given time, while always respecting the profitability limits defined by your business.

Through this connector, Claude can access Zentor data to understand the real profitability of your business and each individual listing, review costs, prices, margins, sales, and alerts, identify opportunities or issues, and help you make better decisions.

For example, you can ask Claude which listings are selling below their minimum profitability threshold, which products have opportunities to improve their pricing, which products are missing cost data, how your sales and net profit have evolved, or why a price change was blocked.

When requested, Claude can also use Zentor to perform actions such as applying recommended prices, setting minimum prices or profitability thresholds, and updating costs, while keeping you in control of the decisions that impact your business.

Zentor turns all the information from your Mercado Libre account into concrete decisions and actions that help increase profitability, give you greater control, and reduce the time spent on day-to-day operations.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Zentor to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Zentor to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.zentor.io/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Zentor MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Zentor lists 15 MCP tools, including apply_price_recommendation, get_earnings_breakdown_timeseries, get_notifications, get_prices_by_sku, get_sales_summary, get_sku_costs, get_unknown_products, import_custom_labels, load_costs_config, mark_notifications_as_read, retry_price_change_with_safety_override, and update_minimum_margin.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Zentor?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Zentor in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.
Zentor requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Zentor is developed by Zentor. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
